a.text: Concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least 3 rounds (operate, operate, take), so we'd both very likely end with nothing. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break the deal by surprise. Do you have a proposal? If either of us takes early, let's say so in our messages. Whoever ends up holding cells could then keep operating to help refill the reserve for the other.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood, I'll stick to the agreement and operate. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
